description: List the authenticated user's connected outreach senders: Gmail mailboxes, LinkedIn accounts and WhatsApp accounts, with the exact mailboxId / linkedinAccountId / whatsappAccountId other inputs take. Each LinkedIn account sends at most 30 invites and messages a day, shared by every campaign that sends from it, and each campaign at most its own linkedinDailyLimit (20 by default, a campaign setting); both count LinkedIn only, never the cadence's e-mails. sentToday and sentTodayByCampaign say how much of today's quota is used and by which campaign. When a campaign's account is full, its LinkedIn steps wait for tomorrow; a campaign can be moved to another account of the workspace with room. The account limit is fixed per workspace (30 for most); it cannot be raised here. A channel that is not listed is not connected; it is connected in Settings → Integrations.
name: list_outreach_senders
title: Listar contas de envio
